description: Reviewed practical starter protocols for legacy Growth Zones that previously had zero trusted coverage. Each entry is promoted only after its public content is replaced by a bounded low-risk protocol; legacy collection names do not imply validation of a method or theory.

30-min-eye-break-tracker.note: Public content is replaced by a low-risk screen-break checkpoint. Fixed timing, medical benefit claims, productivity claims and inherited evidence-like language are removed; the protocol is framed as a work-quality pause, not treatment.

478-breathing-technique-guide.note: Public content is replaced by a conservative unforced breathing pause. The inherited 4-7-8 prescription, treatment-like expectations and research-sounding claims are removed; users are told to stop if the exercise feels uncomfortable or causes light-headedness.

create-win-win-outcomes.note: Public content is replaced by an interest-and-trade option map. It does not promise mutual gain or imply that every conflict has a win-win solution; a clear no-deal or boundary remains valid.

achieve-multiple-goals-at-once.note: Public content is replaced by a compatible-goals planning protocol. Unsupported multi-goal performance claims are removed and the user is instructed to separate goals when combining them weakens quality, attention, privacy or safety.

leave-an-app-review.note: Public content is replaced by a neutral observation-impact-suggestion feedback protocol. App-growth, engagement and outcome claims from inherited copy are not retained.

automatic-paycheck-to-savings.note: Public content is replaced by general financial-hygiene guidance for a small reversible savings automation. It explicitly preserves essential obligations and avoids individualized financial advice, savings-rate prescriptions and unsupported outcome claims.

challenge-generalizations-counterexample.note: Public content is replaced by a generic counterexample logic check. The legacy NLP collection is retained only as compatibility navigation; the protocol makes no claim that NLP is scientifically validated or necessary for the technique.

ancestral-torch-resilience-tracker.note: Public content is replaced by a short controllable-next-step reminder. Ancestry, resilience-performance and motivational outcome claims are removed; the phrase is kept only if it changes a concrete next action.

decision-calibration-journal.note: Public content is replaced by ordinary decision-calibration journaling. The legacy Quantum collection is explicitly separated from the protocol and no personal-decision claim is inferred from quantum mechanics.

ai-premortem-risk-planner.note: Public content is replaced by a bounded AI-assisted premortem. Model output is treated only as candidate failure modes, sensitive information must not be shared, and important risks require verification against the real plan before mitigation.

30-min-eye-break-tracker.reason: The effective protocol interrupts long screen stretches and uses the pause as a work-quality checkpoint. Digital Attention and Error Prevention are the concrete Topics; Avoid Errors remains compatibility navigation.

478-breathing-technique-guide.reason: The effective content is a brief, comfortable pause intended to create space before the next action without treatment framing. Stress Regulation is the concrete Topic; Be Calm remains compatibility navigation.

create-win-win-outcomes.reason: The effective protocol maps interests, constraints and possible trades before choosing an agreement or no-deal. Strategy and Negotiation are the user-facing Topics; Game Theory remains a Method lens rather than proof of a win-win outcome.

achieve-multiple-goals-at-once.reason: The effective protocol checks whether one concrete action can serve two compatible priorities without hiding trade-offs. Planning & Prioritization and Goals are the concrete Topics; Grandmaster remains legacy navigation.

leave-an-app-review.reason: The effective protocol converts an observation into clear feedback by separating event, impact and optional suggestion. Revision & Feedback and Clear Communication are the concrete Topics; Grow Together remains compatibility navigation.

automatic-paycheck-to-savings.reason: The effective content is a reversible savings-automation hygiene protocol with explicit affordability boundaries. Personal Finance is the concrete Topic; Money remains compatibility navigation.

challenge-generalizations-counterexample.reason: The effective protocol tests absolute statements using genuine counterexamples. Critical Thinking and Cognitive Biases describe the practical task; NLP is retained only as a legacy review-required Method attached to the collection, not as scientific support.

ancestral-torch-resilience-tracker.reason: The effective protocol acknowledges difficulty and redirects attention to one controllable action. Stress Regulation and Psychological Flexibility are the concrete Topics; Phrases remains compatibility navigation.

decision-calibration-journal.reason: The effective protocol records expectations, confidence and assumptions before outcomes are known, then compares them later. Decision Making and Metacognition are the concrete Topics. The legacy Quantum collection remains only the stable compatibility URL, and its historical quantum-analogy lens is deliberately excluded from machine retrieval for this reviewed protocol.

ai-premortem-risk-planner.reason: The effective protocol uses AI to brainstorm candidate failure modes, then requires human verification before mitigation. Error Prevention, Decision Making and Work Systems are the concrete Topics; Thinking remains compatibility navigation.
